HOOPS HERO - EVERY SET OF UPDATES YOU ASKED FOR
================================================
College basketball dynasty sim
Compiled: September 6, 2026
Each block is one set of updates you requested, in the order they landed.


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 1 - THE ORIGINAL GAME
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Standalone college basketball dynasty sim (first called The Program)
- All 365 Division I programs
- Prestige ratings, recruiting, possession-based simulation
- Full NCAA tournament with Selection Sunday and a bracket
- Play up to 100 seasons as a coach
- Historical records
- No login required; playable as a public app
- Later renamed Hoops Hero


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 2 - STARTING A CAREER
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Title screen with only the game name and button options
- Uploaded arena photo as the home / title-screen background
- Cover art changed to the uploaded picture
- Career mode: first jobs limited to lower-tier / lower-prestige schools
- Pick a school (dynasty): any of the 365 programs
- Eras mode on the main menu: start a career in any decade
    * Real-world results from that decade drive team ratings / prestige
    * NIL off in every era except the 2020s
    * No 3-point line before 1986
    * Conference membership accurate to the selected decade only
    * Career / Pick a school keep modern conference alignments
- Create-a-coach at the start (name, age, alma mater)
- Alma mater wants you more on the carousel
- Remove the Play Now button
- Pick-a-school list must be tappable
- Working Pick a team / Take this job button for Career, Pick a school, and Eras


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 3 - ROSTER, MORALE, AND PLAYERS
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Full roster with ratings, year, position
- Team names clickable for history and bio
- Players clickable
- Meet with players: pep talk / check-in to raise morale
- Individual morale from each player's wants
    * Playing time, winning, touches, stage / spotlight, NIL
- Personality traits affect how they respond
- Rebalance morale so it does not tank no matter what you do
- Talent progression / development over seasons
- Player skill chart
- Tired players can be substituted back in after sitting
- Kentucky description set to "Salena's team"
- Historical player records at each school and overall


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 4 - LIVE GAME / PLAY GAME
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Possession-by-possession simulation
- Play calls actually run the called play
- In-game commentary on Play Game, not only on sim
- Utah State "I Believe" chant when playing as or against Utah State
- ESPN GameCast-style visualizer that follows play-by-play
- Matchup preview and prediction for each game
- Postgame box score
- Postgame press conference
    * Multiple-choice questions about how the game went
    * More questions and answers
    * Options that are not all positive / pointed


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 5 - SIMULATION ENGINE
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Sim one game without advancing extra games
- Sim Game button works on its own (do not force Play then Simulate to End)
- Sim week advances the current week only
- Sim regular season until the conference tournament
- Home-court advantage in the sim, moving with live home results
- Neutral sites, NCAA, conference tourney, MTEs, and The Crown have no campus edge


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 6 - SCHEDULE AND MTEs
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Conference schedules for every league
- Custom non-conference schedule builder (kept after it disappeared once)
- Join / leave multiple-team events (MTEs)
- Holiday events: Maui, Atlantis, Charleston Classic, and the rest of the MTE slate
- MTEs are real multi-game events, not a single exhibition


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 7 - RECRUITING, NIL, AND THE PORTAL
----------------------------------------------------------------
- High school recruiting board
- Scout, offer, campus visit
- ESPN Top 100 recruits page
- Recruits have specific wants that vary in importance
    * Proximity to home
    * Early playing time
    * Coach play style
    * Academic prestige
    * NIL demands
- NIL budget only decreases when spent on a player
- Weekly hours split between recruiting and NIL fundraising
- CPU can recruit for you
- Transfer portal in the offseason; portal players go into the recruiting pool
- NIL donor mood and budget that adjust from results
- Emails from NIL donors reacting to results
- NIL deal mechanics (term, shape, cap hit, roster carryover)
- NIL hidden in Eras except the 2020s


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 8 - RANKINGS AND BOARDS (FIRST PASS)
----------------------------------------------------------------
- AP Top 25
- NET rankings with a resume / quadrant breakdown
- KenPom efficiency rankings
- Bubble Watch
- League / conference standings
- Home-court advantage ranking tab
    * Current home win streak
    * Dynamic from results
    * Edge, home W-L, quality home wins
- Ranking tabs styled like the real websites
- College basketball themed backgrounds that do not wash out the text
- Mobile formatting for every tab


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 9 - BRACKETOLOGY (FIRST PASS)
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Bracketology tab for current tournament predictions
- Separate CBS desk and ESPN desk
- Tab label is "Bracketology", not "Board"
- Committee board, seed list, auto bids, at-large field
- NIT projection and The Crown projection
- Bubble board


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 10 - POSTSEASON (FIRST PASS)
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Conference tournaments; winner gets the automatic NCAA bid
- Selection Sunday reveal
- NCAA / NIT / The Crown selection shows
- Full NCAA bracket (play-in through championship)
- NIT tournament
- The Crown tournament (NIT alternative)
- Play or sim tournament games
- Do not stall at the selection show
- Next-season button not covered by the bottom tabs
- Play up to 100 seasons with full offseasons between them


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 11 - NEWS AND MAIL
----------------------------------------------------------------
- News tab with national headlines from games around the country
- Email from the athletic director, periodic, tied to performance
- Emails from NIL donors
- Inbox with unread count


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 12 - AWARDS, TROPHIES, AND RECORDS
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Preseason awards
- Postseason awards (all-conference, All-American, player of the year)
- Trophy room
    * Conference regular-season and tournament championships
    * NCAA bids, Sweet 16, Elite 8, Final Four, championships
    * NIT berths and success
    * The Crown bids and results
- Records tab
    * School history back to 1900
    * NCAA championship counts (Kentucky 8 official titles, not 9)
    * Conference history
    * Coach records (user and CPU) at each school, conference, and NCAA
    * Player records at each school and overall
    * Historical coaching records going forward


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 13 - COACHING, CONTRACTS, AND THE CAROUSEL
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Coaching skill chart: offense, defense, recruiting, talent development, leadership
- Earn progression points and spend them on a skill tree
- End-of-season coaching skill points
- Contracts: varying lengths and expectations
- Coaching carousel
    * Each school has a named head coach
    * Jobs only open when a team fires, a coach retires, or a successful coach leaves for the NBA
    * Hire is not guaranteed; percentage based on performance
    * Only offer jobs you have proven successful enough for
    * Alma mater increases that school's desire to hire you
    * Successful coaches occasionally leave for the NBA
    * Retirement as a reason a job can open
    * Carousel recap of every coaching change
- Career climb from lower-tier jobs upward


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 14 - OFFSEASON
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Recruiting including the transfer portal
- Coaching carousel
- NIL budget adjustments from donor satisfaction
- Player development
- Spend leftover coaching points
- Continue to next season (up to 100)


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 15 - SAVES
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Automatic saving
- Multiple save files
- Duplicate / delete / switch saves
- Continue from last save


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 16 - LOOK, LANGUAGE, AND POLISH
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Polished UI with basketball-themed backgrounds per tab
- Ranking tabs look like the real sites (AP, NCAA/NET, KenPom, ESPN, CBS)
- Restore the uploaded title-screen picture
- Remove extra descriptive text on the title screen (name + buttons only)
- Change "chair" to "job"
- Change "slate" to "schedule"
- Get rid of text referring to the chair and a frozen copy
- Full tab names (Bracketology, not Board)
- Mobile formatting on all tabs
- Cover art / OG image 1200x630 for link previews
- X feed banner 50:11 from the uploaded image
- Kentucky listed with 8 championships, not 9


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 17 - ERAS MODE (HISTORICAL)
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Start in any decade from the main menu
- Real-world decade results drive ratings / prestige
- NIL only in the 2020s
- No 3-point line before 1986
- Conference associations accurate to that era only
    (Pac-8 / Pac-10, Big Eight, SWC, Metro, independents, etc.)
- Regular Career / Pick a school stay on today's map


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 18 - PLATFORMS AND SHARING
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Make the game publicly available so it can be shared
- Playable link that does not require a Grok login
- Visibility / private-share issues when sending to friends
- Standalone SPA that is actually playable
- iOS Xcode export for App Store upload
- Android / Play Store build
- Privacy policy, store listing, app icon
- New share cards (og.jpg and x-banner.jpg)


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 19 - BUGS AND PLAYABILITY FIXES
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Sim one game was simulating several - fix the engine
- Sim Game button did nothing unless you Play then Simulate to End
- NIL budget draining with no recruiting
- Play calls in live coaching not running the called play
- Tired / subbed players could not be subbed back in
- NET rankings not working correctly
- Custom schedules and MTE join disappeared
- Pick a school showed an untappable text list
- Pick a team button not starting any mode
- Game stuck at the Selection Sunday / postseason
- Next-season button covered by the bottom tab bar
- Players not clickable for pep talks
- Tab still said "Board" after being renamed Bracketology
- Title screen not playable / only showed the title as text
- Public / grok.me / Netlify share links broken or private
- Press conferences too thin; needed more answers including negative ones
- Morale tanking too fast
- Kentucky championship count wrong (9 instead of 8)


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 20 - iOS / SAFARI / GROK APP TAPS
----------------------------------------------------------------
- iOS and Safari tap reliability (menus actually open)
- Hash title nav (#hh-career, #hh-dynasty, etc.) so iframe taps register
- visualViewport resize and scroll drive the dock gap, not document scroll
- Pinch-zoom does not shove the tab bar
- Framed Grok preview gets extra dock padding so tabs sit above the remix pill
- Keyboard / URL-bar gap tracked so chrome does not cover buttons


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 21 - GAMECAST AND PLAY CALLING
----------------------------------------------------------------
- GameCast visualizer accuracy (shot location, make/miss, possession)
- Play calling with hidden results until the play runs
- The play you call is the play they run


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 22 - 30-GAME REGULAR SEASON AND MTEs
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Regular season capped at 30 games
- Max 3 games per week
- 18 regular-season weeks
- Confirm MTEs are real multi-game events
- Bigger schools can decline if your prestige is too low


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 23 - MANUAL SAVES AND HISTORY
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Confirm manual save (named slots, not only autosave)
- Named save files plus autosave
- Cap of 8 manual files
- Multi-season stats and history persist
- Trophy / bid / title history carries across seasons
- Titles only if you actually win the NCAA tournament (no phantom banners)
- You cannot skip March into the offseason


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 24 - REAL NCAA TOURNAMENT SELECTION
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Real committee selection, not a poll-slice fake March
- 32 automatic bids (every conference tournament champion)
- 36 at-large bids
- Field of 68
- First Four: two 16-seed autos and two 11-seed at-larges
- Seeds and regions kept through the Round of 64 to the title
- CPU conference tournaments simmed; yours is scheduled (top 8, you always in)
- Committee score from W-L, conference W, prestige, SOS, quality wins, bad losses
- NIT 32-team field
- The Crown 16-team field
- Review and lock this so March actually happens


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 25 - RANKINGS: KENPOM, NET, AND AP (FULL BOARDS)
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Confirm the Rankings tab includes KenPom, the NET, and the AP poll
- They were missing; a generic poll was replaced with three boards
- NET based on bracketologists.com
    * All 365 teams, not a top-whatever cut
    * Q1-Q4 quadrants, previous rank, path, non-D1
    * Cutoff line
    * Movement arrows
- KenPom tab the same as kenpom.com
    * All 365 teams
    * AdjEM / AdjO / AdjD / AdjT, Luck, SOS, OppO / OppD, NCSOS and ranks
- AP poll ranks all 365 teams (points 1-25, also-receiving 26-40)
- Search on every board
- Site-faithful skins for all three


----------------------------------------------------------------

- ESPN Bracketology styled like ESPN / Joe Lunardi
- CBS SportsLine styled like CBS Sports
- Rank the full field of 68 on each desk, not a short top list
- ESPN leans resume / AP before the field locks
- CBS leans NET and KenPom before the field locks
- After Selection Sunday both desks show the official 68
- Last Four In / First Four Out / Next Four Out

- Menus were overflowing so you could not reach the entire menu

- Horizontal clip so KenPom / NET tables cannot push the app sideways
- Dock stays on screen in the Grok iframe


----------------------------------------------------------------
SET 28 - BRACKETOLOGY IN THE GROK APP + SELECTION SUNDAY SHOW
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Bracketology still did not format inside the Grok app iframe
- ESPN: one region at a time (East / West / South / Midwest), names wrap
- CBS: one region at a time; Seed lines still available as a chip
- No sideways scroll; dock stays put
- After conference tournaments, a Selection Sunday reveal show
    1. The committee has set the field
    2. 1-seeds, 2-seeds, 3-seeds
    3. Rest of the 68
    4. Your envelope - seed and region, or NIT / Crown / home
- Skip to the board, or watch it through
- Sim week will not tip the First Four until you open it or skip
- Office card stays spoiler-free ("Watch Selection Sunday") until then
- Official ESPN / CBS board after the reveal

EXPLORE / DESIGN ASKS (NOT A SHIPPED SET)

- Explore player personality traits impact

That's every set: original dynasty sim through Eras, recruiting, pressers,
